title: Advisory contract + compatibility header schema for model capability exposure
creator: Priya Nair
description: Introduce an 'advisory contract' and a lightweight compatibility header to the Models API to surface model capability hints, stable version pins, and performance bounds that drive routing, fallback, and client-side validation. This ticket defines the API surface, the JSON contract, and the rollout/migration plan. The goal is to allow clients (Console, Dedicated router, Private control plane) to make deterministic routing and pinning decisions without parsing full model manifests or depending on runtime-only endpoints.
acceptance_criteria:
1) New endpoints and header documented in API spec and SDKs.
2) Router and Console can consume advisory header to prefer compatible variants during routing.
3) Backwards compatibility maintained: clients that ignore header see no change.
4) Canary rollout executed with telemetry to validate p50/p95/p99 shifts.
5) End-to-end integration tests cover: header propagation, pin enforcement, and fallback to published model variants.
implementation_plan:
1) Define advisory JSON contract (fields below).
2) Implement advisor generation in model onboarding pipeline (onboarder).
3) Expose advisor via GET /v2/models/{model_id}/advisor and include compact header X-Redwood-Model-Advisor in model list responses.
4) Update router to evaluate 'compatibility_score' and 'latency_bounds' before committing a pin.
5) Update SDKs to surface advisory as Model.capabilities/advisor.
6) Run 2-week canary on a non-critical customer cohort, monitor regression metrics, and iterate.
api_examples:
-- GET advisor (full):
GET /v2/models/gptx-1/advisor
Response 200: {
  "model_id": "gptx-1",
  "stable_pin": "gptx-1:v2025-01-18",
  "capabilities": ["chat", "structured-output", "function-calls"],
  "latency_bounds_ms": {
    "p50": 20, 
    "p95": 85, 
    "p99": 140
  },
  "limits": {
    "context_tokens": 32768,
    "max_tokens_per_request": 4096
  },
  "variant_hints": ["quant8", "bf16"],
  "compatibility_score": 0.92,
  "stability_score": 0.87,
  "generation_cost_units": 1.3
}

-- Compact header included in model list responses: X-Redwood-Model-Advisor: v=1;id=gptx-1;pin=gptx-1:v2025-01-18;cs=0.92;lb=20/85/140;ct=32768

Clients can parse the header to get a quick routing hint without an extra API call.
advisory_contract_spec:
Fields (flat, snake_case):
- model_id (string) -- canonical model identifier.
- stable_pin (string | null) -- recommended pinned version for stable behavior.
- capabilities (array[string]) -- high-level features (chat, embeddings, rerank, structured-output, tool-calling).
- latency_bounds_ms (string) -- p50/p95/p99 numeric tuple or header compact form.
- limits (array[string]) -- context_tokens, max_tokens_per_request expressed in ints.
- variant_hints (array[string]) -- supported runtime artifacts (e.g. quant8, int4, bf16).
- compatibility_score (string) -- float 0..1; heuristic combining capability-match, tokenization-compatibility, model-size-affinity.
- stability_score (string) -- float 0..1; measured from release churn and regression history.
- generation_cost_units (string) -- unitized cost estimate for routing heuristics.
- publish_time (string) -- ISO8601 when advisor was generated.

Note: all numeric values are surfaced as numbers in JSON responses; header uses compact encoding for low-overhead clients.
migration_notes:
- Existing model listing endpoints will add the compact header; this is opt-in for routers initially.
- Onboarder: generate advisor as part of model ingestion; store advisor alongside existing manifest.
- For models without an advisor, router should fall back to existing manifest data and default heuristics.
- SDKs: add Model.advisor nullable field and helper methods to parse the header.
- Backfill: run advisor generator for models in 'stable' catalog over a weekend job to avoid load spikes.
- Deprecation: no deprecations planned; advisory is additive.
testing_and_validation:
- Unit tests for advisor JSON serializer and header encoder/decoder.
- Integration tests: router+onboarder using testbench models with synthetic latency profiles.
- Load test to validate header addition on model list endpoints (no significant extra CPU).
- Canary monitoring: track p50/p95/p99, request latency tail, model error rate, and cost delta per token.
- Automated regression alerts if p95 increases > 10% during canary.
rollout_plan:
1) Implement advisor generation and header support behind feature flag.
2) Release SDKs with parser but default to ignore.
3) Enable router evaluation of compatibility_score for 5% traffic.
4) After 72h stable, increase to 25%, then 100% across non-critical routes.
5) Enable on Reserved/Dedicated paths after validation.
6) Document in Console release notes and expose advisory in model detail view.
